title: The waste hierarchy
caption: Options for waste in order of preference: prevent it in the first place, reuse, recycle, recover energy (incineration), and only last dispose of it in landfill.
alt: A tree working down the hierarchy: can the waste be prevented? Otherwise reused? Otherwise recycled? Otherwise burned for energy? Otherwise disposed of.
description: Prevent: design processes that make less waste.

claims.substance: a waste that can only be burned
